en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a portrait studio. A man with glasses sits at a table covered with a patterned cloth, resting his head on one hand and holding a pen in the other. On the table are flowers and a small statue. Several upholstered chairs surround the table. Behind him is a painted scenic backdrop with trees and mountains and heavy curtains. On the right side are lace curtains, a plant stand with potted plants, and a small side table with a cloth. Text identifying the photographic studio is printed in white in the upper left corner.
